tip: Word order flips the meaning: jam dua = two o'clock, but dua jam = two hours. Here janji kita jam dua = our appointment at two.
tadi = earlier, in the recent past: tadi malam = last night. It pairs with nanti – nanti looks ahead, tadi looks back.
minggu means week, but Minggu with a capital M is Sunday: hari Minggu = on Sunday, minggu depan = next week. Case decides.
